_3_HOW_TO_ORDER_PAGE: HOW TO ORDER PAGE: the step-by-step guide customers open from the menu, the Home button, the Shop page and the cart. Edit the steps to match how you work.

guide.title: How to order
guide.intro: Follow these steps. It only takes a minute.

steps.title: Choose your items
steps.text: Pick your game on the Shop page, then tap Add to cart on the items you want.

steps.title: Enter your game details
steps.text: Open your cart and type your game ID (for example User ID and Server ID), your name and your WhatsApp number. Check them carefully, because we top up this account.

steps.title: Choose how to pay
steps.text: Bank transfer: we show our bank details and your order number. Transfer the exact total and type your order number in the remarks box. Or order via WhatsApp and we confirm with you first.

steps.title: Send your proof
steps.text: After you transfer, tap Send proof on WhatsApp so we can confirm your payment quickly.

steps.title: Receive your items
steps.text: We top up your account as soon as your payment is confirmed.

guideTexts.shopHint: New here? See how to order
guideTexts.cartHelp: Need help? See how to order
